name: Push banner
author: Brett
description: A banner listing every branch that isn't on main yet in AmberX-AXF and axHub (commits ahead/behind, age, last commit, its open PR and that PR's CI), with Open PR and Merge: every change reaches main only through its PR (one is opened for every branch), brought up to date with main and re-tested before it merges (not behind, CI passed on the pinned head; re-checked on the server). Auto-merge takes ready PRs oldest first, one merge per round, and sets branch protection on main where the token may. Auto-land (land/land.mjs, plain scripts on the VPS, no model calls) lands every finished build: worktree cleaned, main merged in with the builds files newer-wins, PR opened, CI started, merged here in dependency order once green and not held by UI Review; blocked builds are pushed to Brett once, in plain words. The console server talks to GitHub with its own token, which never reaches the browser. Merge queue (0.7.0): GitHub's own merge queue needs an organisation-owned repo, so the queue is ours: ready PRs line up, each is tested once on top of main + every PR ahead of it (queue/pr-<n> branches), the green head merges with no retest, a red one is kicked out with the reason in plain words and the ones behind it are retested without it; CI runs only what a change touches, PRs run light checks while the queue is on. Merge queue view, banner chip, REST + MCP + CLI. 0.7.1 (Nov 4 2026, Brett: "Stop merging these things one at a time"): auto-land is off by default and only the merge queue merges AmberX-AXF; GitHub reads are cached with ETags (a 304 costs no API call) and held back when the shared limit runs low; the console redeploys once per stack. 0.8.0 (Nov 10 2026, Brett: "Take all the pull requests as soon as they're ready, have the orchestrator combine them, like five at a time, into one big build. Then pull main and merge it as one."): batch mode, the default: up to 5 (setting) ready PRs combined into one queue/batch-<n> branch on the latest main, CI once, main pulled in again if it moved, merged as one PR; a red batch is halved until the PR at fault is kicked out; a code conflict inside a batch waits for the next batch, or goes to a queue-conflict agent job when the AI fallback is on. Every finished build gets a PR and joins the queue (red or missing light checks join behind the green ones: the batch run is the real gate); Merge on AmberX-AXF puts the PR in the queue. Settings over REST / MCP / CLI.

items.title: Auto-land: every finished build
items.description: Every finished build the pipeline lands, in landing order, with its PR, state and what it waits on.

items.title: Auto-land: blocked builds
items.description: Finished builds that are not landing, each with the reason in plain words (UI waiting, CI red, conflict, dependency).

items.title: Auto-land: land a build now
items.description: Land one finished build at the next round (within 3 minutes), ahead of the rest; a hold on it is released.

items.title: Auto-land: hold a build
items.description: Keep a finished build from landing until it is released.

items.title: Auto-land: release a held build
items.description: Let a held build land again.

items.title: Merge queue: the line
items.description: Every PR in the merge queue in order: title, agent, test state (waiting, testing, passed, kicked out and why), ETA in minutes; the batch being tested (PRs combined, CI run, result) and the last batches; plus the open PRs not in it and why, the last merged and kicked-out ones. Batch mode (default): up to batchSize ready PRs are combined on the latest main, CI runs once and the batch merges as one; stack mode: each PR tested on top of the ones ahead.

items.title: Merge queue: settings
items.description: The merge queue's settings: on, mode (batch = ready PRs combined batchSize at a time into one build on the latest main, one CI run, merged as one; stack = each PR tested on top of the ones ahead), batchSize (1-10, default 5), aiResolve (a code conflict inside a batch goes to a queue-conflict agent job), depth (stack mode).

items.title: Merge queue: change settings
items.description: Change the merge queue's settings: on (true/false), mode (batch or stack), batchSize (1-10), aiResolve (true/false), depth (1-6, stack mode). Takes effect at the next round (within 3 minutes).

aiResolve.description: send a code conflict inside a batch to an agent job

depth.description: stack mode: PRs tested at once

items.title: Merge queue: add a PR
items.description: Put a PR (back) in the merge queue: undoes Remove from queue or a kick-out at the same head. It still has to be ready (PR checks green, not a draft, not held by UI Review). Takes effect at the next round (within 3 minutes).

items.title: Merge queue: remove a PR
items.description: Take a PR out of the merge queue until it gets a new commit or is added again; the PRs behind it are retested without it.

items.title: Merge queue: move a PR
items.description: Move a PR to a new place in the merge queue (index, 0 = front). Jump to front is Brett's own click in the console; a session or agent may move a PR anywhere else. The stack behind the new place is retested in the new order.

to.description: new index, 1 or more from a session (0 = front is Brett's click)

items.title: Merge queue: settings
items.description: Batch mode (one build of up to batchSize ready PRs, one CI run, lands as one commit; a red batch is split in half until the PR that broke it is kicked out) or the per-PR stack, the batch size, and the queue on. Switching it off is Brett's own click. Returns the queue.

on.description: queue on (off is Brett's click only)
